workLog.description: Read issue #4607, ADR-026 Decision 5, retrospective 2026-08-05; mapped BOT_PAT/GH_TOKEN wiring across .github/workflows and the ai-review action

Wiring passes secrets.BOT_PAT consistently; defect is (a) secret value belongs to human account (operator-only) and (b) no run log reports the resolved identity because verify_github_auth.py is gated behind enable-diagnostics=false and never compares the id
Added scripts/ci/check_bot_identity.py (stdlib-only, MATCH/MISMATCH/MISSING/UNKNOWN verdicts, strict mode with nonzero exits) with 18 tests
Wired the diagnostic unconditionally into .github/actions/ai-review/action.yml and pr-maintenance.yml discover-prs; 3 wiring tests parse the YAML
QA report at .agents/qa/2026-08-15-pr-5093-bot-identity.md; acceptance criterion cannot pass until the owner rotates BOT_PAT, stated plainly

Pre-push python-tests gate failed on environment gaps unrelated to the diff: installed missing sqlite3 CLI, and made the orphan-ref-validator permission-denied test euid-independent (chmod 0 is ignored under root CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE); mirror synced byte-for-byte
